about_the_game:
A DARK JOURNEY OF ACTION AND ADVENTURE

Take on the role of a pilgrim, a monk turned warrior, destined to carry a fragment of forbidden power: the relic. This ancient object, capable of summoning a spectral sword, is both your salvation and your curse. Your mission is to cross a ruined world, open sealed paths, and resist the shadows that crave the power you bear.

• A somber and evocative world

Explore a landscape that blends open spaces with linear scenarios, creating a “mini open world” experience. Among forgotten ruins, crumbling temples, and corrupted wastelands, every corner hides secrets and dangers. Solving puzzles, understanding the environment, and uncovering the lost history of the fallen orders will be as essential as wielding your sword.

• Challenging and intense combat

Combat in Unchained Relic is straightforward yet demanding: basic strikes, heavy blows, and special moves combine with the relic’s unique abilities. The key lies in strategy, learning the patterns of corrupted creatures, mastering the timing of your attacks, and discovering new ways to invoke the dark power of your weapon.

• The relic, your burden and your weapon

The small relic you carry is more than just a fragment, it is a connection to the original artifact that nearly destroyed the world. With it, you can summon a mystical sword capable of opening sealed doors and facing impossible foes. Yet this power comes at a price, and each use brings you closer to the truth behind the corruption.

• A dark and religious narrative

In a world marked by the fall of kingdoms, the betrayal of sacred orders, and the corruption of faith, your journey is more than survival: it is a search for meaning. You will encounter lost pilgrims, fallen kings, and corrupted nuns who embody what has been sacrificed in the name of power. The story unfolds gradually, in a dark and symbolic tale.

• Creatures of the shadows

Face enemies born of pain and corruption: lost souls, deformed humans, forgotten monarchs, nameless monsters, and profaned giants. Each encounter is a test of your endurance and a reminder of the weight of the relic you carry.

content_descriptors.notes:
Unchained Relic contains the following mature themes:

Violence and Gore: Frequent depictions of combat with bladed weapons, including blood and some dismemberment.

Dark Religious Themes: The game explores corruption of faith, fallen holy figures, and desecrated religious imagery.

Psychological Horror Elements: Atmosphere and narrative may evoke dread, despair, or loss of sanity.

Mature Story Themes: Includes suffering, death, and the downfall of kingdoms and sacred orders.

There are no depictions of sexual content, sexual assault, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm in the game.

short_description: Unchained Relic is a dark fantasy action-adventure where you play as a pilgrim burdened with a cursed relic. Traverse a corrupted world, solve ancient puzzles, and battle relentless shadows. The relic is your weapon and your curse.
